tested_by: WO-002 writes config/stack-lock.resolved.json after SITL runs
warning: PX4 v1.17 documentation states ROS 2 Humble on Ubuntu 22.04 and does not state this Jazzy on 24.04 combination. Each part is documented separately. Nothing here has been installed or run. See docs/adr/ADR-0007-d0-airframe-and-stack-proposal.md.

os_image_digest_or_distro.digest_question: recorded by WO-002 if a container is used

px4_release_or_commit.note: Latest stable. v1.18.0-rc1 is a pre-release. The release/1.17 branch is 13 commits ahead, one adding LSM6DSV16X support on fmu-v6c; recheck against the actual Pixhawk 6C at hardware time.

ros2_distribution.note: End of life May 2029. Humble ends May 2027. PX4 v1.17's CI builds its translation node on Jazzy but does not run SITL there.

ros2_package_lock.question: cannot be sourced before install; WO-002 records the exact package versions it installs

gazebo_version.note: PX4 v1.17 calls Harmonic the supported, CI-tested version. Gazebo recommends it with Jazzy.

px4_ros2_bridge_commit.note: Agent v3.x is not compatible, though the agent repository marks v3.0.2 as latest. The px4_msgs match to PX4 v1.17.0 is inferred from commit history; WO-002 diffs msg/.

qgroundcontrol_version.note: AppImage supports Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04; 22.04 needs a self-build.

vio_package_and_version.note: For bench evaluation in D2 only, and only on NVIDIA hardware. Not needed by WO-002. No candidate has a published PX4 integration guide on ROS 2, and accuracy is unmeasured. Second candidate if the OAK is chosen: Luxonis BasaltVIO. The full commit hash is read at install.

sensor_driver_commits.value: depthai_ros_v3 3.2.1-1 (tag v3.2.1-jazzy) for OAK-D Pro; realsense2_camera 4.58.4-1 for D435i
sensor_driver_commits.note: Both are versions in the Jazzy apt main repository except depthai_ros_v3, which Luxonis installs with the testing apt source added. Newer versions are in testing only. Exact commits are recorded when a camera is chosen.

flight_controller_firmware_target.note: Pixhawk 6C and Pixhawk 6C Mini. WO-002 uses SITL: make px4_sitl gz_x500. No hardware is connected in D0 or D1.

fallback_pairing.use_if: WO-002 cannot run the proposed pairing
fallback_pairing.value: Ubuntu 22.04, ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo Harmonic, PX4 v1.17.0, Micro-XRCE-DDS-Agent v2.4.2
fallback_pairing.why_not_first: It is the pairing the v1.17 guide states, but Humble ends in May 2027, Gazebo marks Humble with Harmonic 'use with caution', and QGroundControl v5.1 has no 22.04 AppImage.

rule: Every entry is proposed. A null is a question for WO-002, never permission to use latest.
